changelog:
Initial release of ClawAlarm skill for managing iPhone alarms via cloud sync.

- Set, update, snooze, and delete alarms on a paired iPhone running ClawAlarm.
- Pairing uses a secure, one-time code handshake to authenticate and link the device.
- All alarm changes sync via the ClawAlarm cloud API and reconcile to the phone automatically (no app foregrounding required).
- Supports setting alarms with flexible recurrence (daily, weekdays, weekends, custom week masks, or one-off).
- CLI uses a live OpenAPI spec for up-to-date API routes and payloads.
- Token scope is device-limited and safe for personal project environments.
summary: Read, create, update, snooze, and delete alarms on a user's iPhone running ClawAlarm. Use when the user asks to set an alarm, change an existing alarm's time...
